abstract: BACKGROUND: Choriocarcinoma coexisting with endometrial carcinoma is rare. To the best of our knowledge, only one case of choriocarcinoma coexisting with endometrial carcinoma has been reported. CASE PRESENTATION: Here, we present this case and provide a literature review. A 38-year-old unmarried nulliparous woman presented to the clinic with a menstrual disorder for more than 3 months. She then underwent a hysteroscopic procedure. The pathological findings were malignant, two types of carcinoma, and no transitional lesions were observed; about 85% of them were choriocarcinoma with smooth muscle infiltration and intravascular investigation of the thrombus; about 15% were highly differentiated endometrioid adenocarcinoma; Immunohistochemistry (endometrioid/choriocarcinoma): Vim (+ + / + + +), P40 (+ ±), CK5/6 multifocal ( ±), CK7 ( ±), EMA (+ ±), P16 multifocal ( ±), P53 (+ / + +), WT-1 (-/ + +), hCG (-/ + + +), CD138 (-/ + + +), Gly-3 (-/-), ER ( ±), PR (+ ±), Sall-4 (-/-), P21 (-/ +), P27 (-/ + + +), CyclinE (-/ + +), Ki67 positivity rate (10%/95%). We performed a laparoscopic hysterectomy, bilateral adnexectomy, and pelvic and para-abdominal lymph node dissection after five cycles of chemotherapy. She was diagnosed with choriocarcinoma with endometrial cancer, stage IVb choriocarcinoma and stage IA endometrial cancer. Postoperative radiochemotherapy was administered. The patient was disease-free 40 months after the treatment ended. CONCLUSION: We report a case of choriocarcinoma coexisting with endometrial carcinoma and provide a literature review that may help inspire additional studies in the future.
abstract_ja:
背景：絨毛癌と子宮内膜癌の共存はまれである。我々の知る限り、絨毛癌と子宮内膜癌の共存の報告は1例のみである。

症例提示：ここに症例を報告し、文献的考察を行う。38歳の未婚の未経産婦が、3か月以上続く月経異常で受診した。その後、子宮鏡検査を受けた。病理所見は悪性で、2種類の癌が認められ、移行病変は認められなかった。約85%は平滑筋への浸潤および血栓の血管内検索を伴う絨毛癌であり、約15%は高分化類内膜腺癌であった。免疫組織化学(類内膜腺癌/絨毛癌)：Vim(++/+++)、P40(+±)、CK5/6多巣性(±)、CK7(±)、EMA(+±)、P16多巣性(±)、P53(+/++)、WT-1(-/++)、hCG(-/+++)、CD138(-/+++)、Gly-3(-/-)、ER(±)、PR(+±)、Sall-4(-/-)、P21(-/+)、P27(-/+++)、CyclinE(-/++)、Ki67陽性率(10%/95%)。5コースの化学療法後に、腹腔鏡下子宮全摘術、両側付属器切除術、および骨盤内・傍腹部リンパ節郭清を施行した。絨毛癌を伴う子宮体癌、病期IVb期の絨毛癌、病期IA期の子宮体癌と診断された。術後に放射線化学療法を施行した。治療終了後40か月の時点で無病の状態であった。

結論：絨毛癌と子宮体癌が共存した症例を報告し、今後のさらなる研究を促す一助となりうる文献的考察を行う。
